project: Loxley Roofing and Construction — House A Scroll Sequence

continuityLock.instruction: Every scene represents the same house and lot. Never substitute another property or change the massing, facade openings, roof geometry, chimney, portico, garage, driveway or tree placement.

scenes.title: Hero Exterior
scenes.subject: Completed head-on exterior at blue hour with open sky for the wordmark.

scenes.title: Site Preparation
scenes.subject: Cleared and graded lot with equipment, survey stakes, erosion control and the future house footprint.

scenes.title: Foundation
scenes.subject: Poured footings and foundation walls with reinforcement, waterproofing, drainage and inspection.

scenes.title: Floor System
scenes.subject: Engineered floor joists, beams, subfloor panels, openings and active carpentry.

scenes.title: Wall Framing
scenes.subject: First- and second-story wall framing with recognizable facade and garage openings.

scenes.title: Second Floor and Roof Framing
scenes.subject: Roof trusses and hipped roof structure being installed by crane and tied-off carpenters.

scenes.title: Roof Decking
scenes.subject: OSB roof decking with staggered panel joints, dormer openings and fall protection.

scenes.title: Roof Underlayment
scenes.subject: Ice-and-water protection, synthetic underlayment and drip edge across the same roof.

scenes.title: Flashing Details
scenes.subject: Close view of sidewall, chimney, valley and roof-penetration flashing workmanship.

scenes.title: Shingle Installation
scenes.subject: Charcoal architectural shingles progressing from eaves toward ridge over exposed underlayment.

scenes.title: Ridge, Ventilation and Metal Roof
scenes.subject: Final ridge-cap, ventilation and black standing-seam porch-roof details.

scenes.title: Exterior Envelope
scenes.subject: Weather-tight shell with completed roofing, installed windows and Antique White brick veneer underway.

scenes.title: Mechanical Rough-In
scenes.subject: Kitchen-to-family-room view with exposed framing, organized plumbing, electrical and HVAC rough-ins.

scenes.title: Insulation and Drywall
scenes.subject: The same interior camera position with insulation, drywall installation and finishing underway.

scenes.title: Kitchen and Interior Finishes

scenes.title: Roof Quality Inspection

scenes.title: Final Exterior Day
scenes.subject: Completed daytime property with professional crew and work vehicles near the right garage.

scenes.title: Final Exterior Dusk
scenes.subject: Cinematic blue-hour closing view with warm interior light and open sky for the final call to action.
